messages:
sarah (AE): Hey team — customer (FinTech startup) asked if we can do BYOK with HSM-backed keys for production. They specifically mentioned CloudHSM + AWS KMS or a customer HSM appliance (Thales/nCipher). Also need: pricing delta for BYOK, rotation SLA, and timeline for a POC. Any quick answers before I get back to them?

mike (sales-eng): short answer: yes — we support envelope encryption with customer-managed CMKs. Options: AWS KMS CMK (including with CloudHSM or external key stores), GCP CMEK, Azure Key Vault (CNG). For on-prem HSMs we do a secure key handshake/import flow or use HSM-backed KMS via the customer's cloud provider.

mike (sales-eng): example config we send for integration: 
```
key_provider: "aws-kms"
key_id: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-efgh-ijkl"
key_mode: "customer-managed"
import_method: "import-key-material" # or "kms-backed-hsm"
```

julian (solutions): POC logistics — typical plan: 2 weeks. Week 1: connectivity + key import + basic tokenized traffic. Week 2: rotation tests, performance under expected qps, and audit export. We need their infra lead on the first call to exchange certs and determine whether they want HSM-in-cloud or an on-prem appliance. I can run the integration checklist.

ananya (security): Notes on security questions: we support HSM-backed keys and can integrate with customers' FIPS 140-2/3 validated modules. Key rotation is customer-driven; Redwood supports zero-downtime rotation patterns via dual-key active/passive and cache invalidation. We provide audit logs for every key usage (request metadata + key_id) and timestamped export for compliance. We can fill their security questionnaire — we have a standard BYOK appendix.

sarah (AE): Good. They also asked about billing — will BYOK increase hosted pricing or need Dedicated? They mentioned regulatory requirement for isolated hardware.

mike (sales-eng): Pricing: for Hosted + BYOK we add an enterprise connector fee and an HSM gateway surcharge (covers maintenance and secure handshake). Rough ballpark: connector setup one-time $10k–25k and ~$1k/mo connector fee for hosted, plus metered HSM ops if they request dedicated HSM throughput guarantees. For Dedicated (reserved) you'd treat HSM as part of the reserved capacity; pricing comes from the committed GPUs + optional HSM SLA add-on. Exact numbers depend on qps and number of keys. I can run a quick cost model if you paste their expected rps.

mike (sales-eng): If they need FIPS-validated on-prem HSM (Thales/nCipher), we usually recommend Dedicated or Private deployment (VPC) so keys never leave their network. For CloudHSM we can keep hosted but require VPC peering + strict routing policy.

julian (solutions): For the POC checklist I need: (1) key policy docs (who can call encrypt/decrypt), (2) sample key ARNs/certs, (3) test dataset (sanitized), (4) expected qps & max seq len, (5) point of contact for firewall rules. If they need a cert exchange for on-prem HSM, allow 3 business days.

ananya (security): On rotation SLA: we support automated rotation triggers, but final authority is the customer's KMS. We can document a rollback playbook and run a rotation drill during the POC. For the questionnaire item "Do you manage customer keys?" answer: "We do not control key material for BYOK setups — keys are customer-managed; Redwood holds metadata and encrypted references only."

sarah (AE): perfect. I'll ask them for the checklist items and expected qps. Can someone own the cost estimate and the security appendix?

mike (sales-eng): I can do the cost model — tag me with their qps and desired latency SLO.

julian (solutions): I'll own the integration checklist and schedule the handshake call with their infra lead. Suggest Thurs 10am PT?

ananya (security): I'll take the questionnaire + BYOK appendix and flag any open attestations (SOC2/ISO/FIPS) — we have templates.

ops-bot: Ticket created: #POC-4839 — CMK/HSM BYOK POC for FinTech customer. Owner: julian (solutions).

sarah (AE): thanks all — I'll loop back after I get their details. :thumbsup:
